goal: N-03 official desktop ChatGPT account login/logout/select/renewal and secure app-owned credential lifecycle; consume engine Responses adapter without changing provider core or Codex authentication files

implementation.officialFlow: OpenAI OSS SIWC dynamic registration, system browser, 127.0.0.1 /auth/callback, fresh state/nonce/S256 PKCE, issued-client binding, jose JWKS issuer/audience/expiry/nonce verification
implementation.credentialStorage: app accounts subdirectory; owner-only safeStorage encrypted record; insecure Linux basic_text refused; no access/refresh/ID token in renderer or journal
implementation.accountBinding: persisted credentialMode=chatgpt and exact accountId; official Responses URL and account model catalog; no stored/environment API key fallback
implementation.refresh: serialized rotating renewal; durable uncertainty marker before request; quarantine/no auto replay after failed request, crash or persistence failure
implementation.logout: revoke renewable session; erase local tokens and retain client/account mapping; report remote revocation unconfirmed on network failure
implementation.engineBoundary: host admission hold closes prior worker before account mutation; private fresh bearer config only; renderer never receives credential fields

verification.boundary: main service, signed test JWT, actual loopback, AES-GCM test storage; external OpenAI fetch fixture
actual Electron GUI with native operating system safeStorage and official-contract account fixture

externalConditions.releaseCondition: An explicitly authorized isolated Moodcode account sign-in, account-specific model discovery and completed Responses request; no Codex app auth-file changes
